name: A Worthy Hero
source:
You are a hero looking for a great weapon to wield while on your adventures, but first you must prove yourself worthy.

Are you worthy?

[From [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-32/?action=preview&uid=51525]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-32/?action=preview]Ludum Dare 32[/url] (Theme: An Unconventional Weapon).
translation:
你是一名英雄，正在冒险途中寻找一把强大的武器，但首先必须证明自己配得上它。

你够资格吗？

[摘自[url=http://ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-32/?action=preview&uid=51525]Ludum Dare[/url]]
